capabilities.description: Manages preparation, submission and certification of interim progress claims based on BOQ measured quantities and contract rates, calculating retention and generating payment certificates in line with contract clauses.
requirements: progress claims from the uploaded BOQ
Retention: 5% of each Interim Payment Certificate, released 50% at Taking-Over and 50% at the end of the Defects Notification Period
Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record

capabilities.description: Tracks delay days against the Time for Completion, calculates delay damages per contract clause with a cap, and flags exposure when the cap is reached.
requirements: Delay Damages: 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day of delay, capped at 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount
Time for Completion: 730 days from the Commencement Date
Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record

capabilities.description: Manages QA/ITP records for construction activities, including inspection requests, checklists, sign-offs, and non-conformance tracking with evidence capture and verification.
requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record

requirements: Use the uploaded contract and BOQ as the source of record
